messages.subject: Error Encountered with morphol.disparity Function
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am currently conducting research on morphological variations in triatomine bugs, specifically focusing on the heads and wings of resistant strains. I am reaching out to inquire about the possibility of comparing the Procrustes variances between two different sets of morphological structures and configurations of landmarks.

In the head structure, I have identified 5 morphological landmarks, while in the wing structure, there are 11 landmarks that I have considered for analysis.

My research aims to determine which of these structures exhibits greater variability, with a specific focus on understanding the morphological differences in resistant strains. To achieve this, I intend to utilize the morphol.disparity function. However, I encountered an error message stating: "Error: Variables or data might be missing from either the data frame or global environment, or a linear model fit just does not work..."

I would greatly appreciate your guidance on how to address this issue and whether it is feasible to compare the variances of Procrustes between these distinct morphological structures. Additionally, any insights or suggestions you can offer regarding the analysis would be invaluable to my research.

Thank you very much for considering my inquiry. 

Below, I am providing the code I have been working on:

morphol.disparity(TGAHC.gdf$coords~TGAH.gdf$coords+TGAH.gdf$LID,
                  groups = TGAH.gdf$LID,
                  iter = 999)

Kind regards,
Federico.

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Error Encountered with morphol.disparity Function
parts:
Federico,

 

That error is usually associated with not finding your data frame. Please follow the format in the example in the help file, where you specify ‘data = XXX’ where XXX is the name of your geomorph data frame.


Additionally, for the groups you need the format “groups = ~ xxx”.

 

Again see the help file for examples.

 

Dean
